title: Settled resume boundary and Root editor state
objective: Pair each durable transcript boundary with one event-loop-frozen view and publish it without navigation receipts or stale Root mirrors.
requirements: Drain queued renderer updates and finalize streaming before terminal checkpoint commit.
Capture on App.UpdateSync; perform evidence/filesystem I/O after releasing the event loop.
Do not append /resume, /fork, or /clear navigation output to the target presentation.
Restore draft, Unicode rune cursor, deterministic composer viewport, transcript anchor, and scroll before Run.
Clear stale modal/action refs on session publication.
acceptance: pre-Run Root mirror and cursor tests
old captures cannot overwrite newer same-digest checkpoints
result: Canonical resume, event-loop capture, settled commits, command isolation, cursor persistence, root mirror restore, and in-process newest-wins publication are implemented.
